title: Fermat's last theorem
verification: Wiles's modularity proof, repaired with Taylor and published in 1995, is a complete peer-reviewed proof.

title: The Poincaré conjecture
verification: A 2026 Lean formalization of the Hamilton–Perelman route is kernel-checked; Perelman declined the Fields Medal and the Clay prize.

title: The four color theorem
verification: Appel and Haken's computer-assisted proof was the first of its kind; Gonthier later checked a proof in Coq.

title: The Kepler conjecture
verification: Hales proved the density bound in 1998; the Flyspeck formalization was completed in 2014 and checked by proof assistants.

title: The Weil conjectures
verification: Deligne's published proof completed the last of the Weil conjectures and the program Grothendieck had set in motion.

title: The classification of finite simple groups
verification: The proof was assembled across a large body of peer-reviewed papers and surveyed as complete around 2004; no single author owns the closing.

title: The weak Goldbach conjecture
verification: Helfgott's analytic proof combines a published argument with explicit computation over the finite range it leaves open.

title: The prime number theorem
verification: Hadamard and de la Vallée Poussin independently established a zero-free region for the zeta function, yielding the theorem.

title: The Basel problem
verification: Euler's published evaluation established the sum; later analysis supplied the convergence framework used in modern proofs.

title: The quintic's refusal
verification: Abel's accepted impossibility proof rules out a general radical formula; Galois theory later explains the obstruction through nonsolvable groups.

title: The continuum hypothesis
verification: Gödel's constructible universe and Cohen's forcing established relative consistency in both directions, assuming ZFC itself is consistent.

title: The irrationality of e
verification: Euler's infinite continued fraction proves irrationality; the argument dates to 1737 and appeared in print in 1744.
